recognize_zh: Perforin染色在大量大型細胞的細胞質呈強烈、粗顆粒至瀰漫性棕色陽性，核周可見淡染的核，而小淋巴球多為陰性，表示腫瘤細胞具細胞毒性顆粒蛋白，符合ALCL的細胞毒性表型。
features: Strong granular to confluent cytoplasmic perforin staining in numerous large cells
Positive cells have abundant cytoplasm surrounding pale, vesicular nuclei
Positive cells arranged in clusters and sheets
describe_en: Perforin immunostain shows strong granular to confluent cytoplasmic staining in numerous large cells with abundant cytoplasm and pale vesicular nuclei, arranged in clusters and sheets, while interspersed small lymphocytes are negative. Expression of perforin by the large neoplastic cells indicates a cytotoxic phenotype, commonly seen in anaplastic large cell lymphoma, and supports T-cell lineage when pan-T antigens are diminished.

ddx.vs: ENKTL expresses perforin but is EBER-positive and CD56-positive with angiocentricity and necrosis, lacking uniform strong CD30 in hallmark cells.
Macrophage cytoplasm may show nonspecific granular staining, but histiocytes are CD163-positive and lack true perforin granules in atypical cells.
